name: Quarrymaster Saldezaar

abilities.name: Black Gem Splinters
abilities.description: Shards of black gems fall to the ground, creating circular AoEs. They deal damage over time to anyone near them. They can be removed by Quarrymaster Saldezaar's Galvanizing Blow.

abilities.name: Blighted Periphery
abilities.description: The inner and outer perimeters of the quarry will deal damage. Avoid touching the walls.

abilities.name: Galvanizing Blow?
abilities.description: Quarrymaster Saldezaar swings his weapon in a cone, dealing damage and destroying Black Gem Splinters within the AoE.
At (?) and (?)% health, a red ring AoE will appear around the outer or inner area of the quarry. Move out of this to avoid taking damage.

At (?) and (?)% health, a yellow ring AoE will appear around the outer or inner area of the quarry. Stand in this to avoid being smashed into a wall. Also, mind the placement of Black Gem Splinters to avoid being smashed into them as well. On Veteran mode this ability is lethal.

abilities.name: Summon Imp
abilities.description: Imps will spawn and cast shock abilities, and should be killed.

dialogue.speaker: Quarrymaster Saldezaar
dialogue.line: This lot's good for nothing. They couldn't move slower if they trudged through azure plasm.
dialogue.trigger: As you make your way through the quarry, you will overhear a conversation between High Soulbinder Vykand and Quarrymaster Saldezaar.

dialogue.speaker: High Soulbinder Vykand
dialogue.line: And whose fault is that, quarrymaster? Don't tell me you grew soft on these elementals like that pathetic summoner.
dialogue.trigger: As you make your way through the quarry, you will overhear a conversation between High Soulbinder Vykand and Quarrymaster Saldezaar.

dialogue.speaker: Quarrymaster Saldezaar
dialogue.line: I'm not—! I'll make use of them. Every last bit of them. You'll see.
dialogue.trigger: As you make your way through the quarry, you will overhear a conversation between High Soulbinder Vykand and Quarrymaster Saldezaar.

dialogue.speaker: Quarrymaster Saldezaar
dialogue.line: You can't move this measly bunch of gems?
dialogue.trigger: When you enter Saldezaar's arena, you will see him casting a conical attack that destroys several stone atronachs and black gem splinters.

dialogue.line: Pathetic!

related_quests: Deadly Armaments: A regretful summoner needs help destroying arms and armor for the Worm Cult invasion of Solstice.
summary: Quarrymaster Saldezaar is a Dremora who manages the mine in Black Gem Foundry, and serves as that dungeon's first boss. According to Dalenor the Summoner, he is not fond of the other foundry leaders.
